title: Northern Ireland's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Northern Ireland in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Warren Feeney: Warren Feeney is joint 11th with 5, just outside.
notes.Dan Ballard: Dan Ballard is joint 11th with 5, just outside.
notes.Gavin Whyte: Gavin Whyte is joint 11th with 5, just outside.
notes.Iain Dowie: Iain Dowie's 12 goals all came before 2000.
notes.Colin Clarke: Colin Clarke's goals all came before 2000.
notes.James Quinn: James Quinn scored 3 of his 4 from 2000.
notes.Michael Hughes: Michael Hughes scored most of his goals before 2000.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. All ten made their debuts in 2000 or later (Healy in February 2000), so their totals at the cut-off were checked against RSSSF (to 7 June 2026) and Wikipedia's records page and player articles: Healy 36, Lafferty 20, Davis 13, Magennis 12, Price 10, McAuley 9, McNair 7, Evans 6, McGinn 6, Washington 6, and Feeney, Ballard (all 5 of his goals came before the cut-off) and Whyte on 5. The three on 6 fill places 8 to 10 exactly.
